The regression now covers both attachment and Markdown basename fallback through a wrong slash prefix; the deliberately missing slash target remains unresolved. The targeted Rust tests are compiling against the updated resolver now.

The focused tests pass: all four resolver tests and the combined transclusion/file-link regression. The shell redirected Cargo’s build output to a per-run target path despite the environment override, so I’m pinning the requested target explicitly before rerunning the gate.

The rebuilt binary clears all five previously false unresolved-link warnings in focused live dry runs, and the missing targets still remain warnings in the synthetic test. I’m launching a fresh full corpus gate; its continuation will handle the page review, docs, `just check`, and phase closeout.
